d: Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokić put on a HISTORIC show as the Denver Nuggets outlast the Chicago Bulls 151-145 in an overtime thriller! Murray exploded for 45 POINTS, 6 THREE-POINTERS, 5 REBOUNDS and 7 ASSISTS, while Jokić finished with an incredible 37 POINTS, 18 REBOUNDS and 11 ASSISTS for another dominant triple-double. Murray recorded his 9th career 45-point game, passing Alex English for the second-most in Nuggets franchise history, while Jokić extended his NBA record with his 17th career 35-point, 15-rebound, 10-assist game.
